annotations.title: Who tests the web app's versions

description: Who opens the testing addresses of the site's versions, and what to test. access: 'testers' (the emails added here sign in with a code), 'password' (set password too) or 'link' (anyone with the address). add and remove take emails; note is what to test, shown to testers when they sign in. lang: the code email's language for testers without a Ploa account. Without changes it only reads them.

lang.description: The code email's language for testers without a Ploa account ('' for each tester's own page's). People with a Ploa account always get theirs.

password.description: For access: password (6 to 100 characters). Give it to the person, not in a public place.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.
